decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 5 - The 2 No. windows of the extension  facing towards No.34 Edward Road shall only be provided in obscure glass, details of which shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  In addition, the windows shall be fixed, i.e. non-openable, to a point 1.8 metres above floor level. The windows shall be provided in accordance with the details as approved and shall thereafter be retained as provided.

Condition : 6 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension, by reason of positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, are considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, the site characteristics, and the immediate local area.  The proposal would not be harmful to the character and appearance of the house, the building of which it forms part, or the local area in general; neither would it have any undue effect on or be harmful to the amenities of any neighbouring properties.  The development is considered to be in accordance with the relevant provisions of adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), and ENV-H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), of the adopted Unitary Development Plan, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance (Residential Extension Guidelines).
description: Erection of single storey rear extension
